title: Better answers, broader thinking: What students gain from ChatGPT and critical-thinking training
summary: OpenAI发布了一项涉及1000多名学生的随机研究，探讨ChatGPT使用与批判性思维训练对大学真实作业表现、原创性和学生成绩的影响，结果显示结合训练能提升答案质量和思维广度。
highlights: A randomized study of more than 1,000 students examines ChatGPT, critical thinking, originality, and student performance on a real-world university assignment.
